planning.evidenceLimits: Only construction from supplied observations and supported labels is checked; no independent physical inventory, question design, retention or human efficacy claim. planning.moduleContract: Self-contained no-import module. Component-owned delegated click/input/change listeners, each detached on dispose. Checked feedback has a semantic state key; native edits of owned answer fields neutralize it until explicit recheck. No timers/global listeners. Native fieldset pause blocks edits; resume catches programmatic value changes made while paused. Reset clears state without adding handlers.
